call_result_correlation.statement: Both mappings name a native item or tool-use identity that could correlate tool_call and tool_result, but no common governed verifier has validated it.

human_principal_receipt.statement: Both mappings require a principal and decision receipt; neither discovery proves a host-authenticated human identity or durable receipt.

usage_completeness.statement: Both mappings expose candidate usage events; neither discovery proves coverage of every billable main, retry, or helper request.

resume_prefix_checkpoint.statement: Both mappings require a prefix checkpoint hash; neither discovery has a valid native restart-and-replay trace.

terminal_enforcement.statement: Both mappings expose interrupt and terminal events; neither discovery proves that writes are impossible after a Governor terminal.

raw_first_durability.statement: Neither discovery proves an immutable raw-first queue that can be replayed independently after process restart.

claim_boundary: This artifact proves only that two version-locked discovery documents share a candidate seven-kind HostEvent projection shape. It does not prove native semantic equivalence, event authenticity, governed enforcement, compatibility, portability, conformance, or outcome value.
